description: IS NULL和IS NOT NULL操作符功能验证

test_cases.name: 常量IS NULL测试
test_cases.description: 验证非NULL常量的IS NULL操作返回false
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE 1 IS NULL;

test_cases.name: 常量IS NOT NULL测试
test_cases.description: 验证非NULL常量的IS NOT NULL操作返回true
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE 1 IS NOT NULL;

test_cases.name: NULL常量IS NULL测试
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE NULL IS NULL;

test_cases.name: NULL常量IS NOT NULL测试
test_cases.description: 验证NULL IS NOT NULL返回false
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE NULL IS NOT NULL;

test_cases.name: 字段IS NULL测试
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE num IS NULL;

test_cases.name: 字段IS NOT NULL测试
test_cases.description: 验证字段的IS NOT NULL操作
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE num IS NOT NULL;

test_cases.name: 字符串IS NULL测试
test_cases.description: 验证字符串常量的IS NULL操作
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE 'hello' IS NULL;

test_cases.name: 字符串IS NOT NULL测试
test_cases.description: 验证字符串常量的IS NOT NULL操作
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE 'hello' IS NOT NULL;

test_cases.name: 复合条件IS NULL测试
test_cases.description: 验证复合条件中的IS NULL操作
test_cases.sql: SELECT * FROM null_table WHERE num IS NULL AND price > 0;

test_cases.name: COUNT与IS NULL测试
test_cases.description: 验证聚合函数与IS NULL的组合
test_cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM null_table WHERE num IS NOT NULL;
